title: Case: Recipient of an import parcel addressed to a shopping arcade asks to add her shop name
context: DL-942 is an international order held at the destination depot with import charges notified and not yet paid. The label gives the arcade but no unit.
initial_request: I'm honestly lost, so I'll go in order. Person one, on the billing line: can't add my shop name until I pay the import fee. I never said I wouldn't pay! The notice came Sunday, the link's good till the 17th, I was going to do it Friday when I'm paid. Person two, depot supervisor, nice enough: not sure the address can be changed at all, something about imports, he'd email me. Person three is the email, which is two lines of symbols and 'message body could not be displayed'. All I am trying to do is add one line: Fenn & Thistle Framing, Unit 14. It's an arcade. There are thirty-odd shops. Without the shop name it will wander round and then go back overseas, won't it? Can someone add the line, or tell me who can. I'll pay the fee. I'm not arguing about the fee.

events.body: DL-942 is held at Destination depot pending import charges. Notice sent to the recipient 9 Aug; payment link valid to 17 Aug. Charges are not refused and not overdue.

Call note. Caller asked to add a shop name and unit number to the delivery address on DL-942. Agent advised: no amendments of any kind to a consignment while import charges are outstanding. Pay first, then call back about the address.

Call note, depot supervisor. Caller asked again about adding shop name. Supervisor said he was not sure an address line can be changed at all on an import consignment once it has cleared in under that address. Said it would be Routing control's call, not the depot's and not billing's. Will email caller the details.
Dear Ms Roux, further to your call re DL-942 =C3=A2=E2=82=AC=E2=84=A2 =3D=3D [message body could not be displayed] =C2=A0=C2=A0 Regards, Destination depot. Copy to Rivet Delivery Desk.

DL-942 label reads 'T. Roux, Copperwell Arcade, Harrow Quay'. Copperwell Arcade has thirty-plus units and no central post room. Arcade parcels with no unit come back off the van as 'address incomplete', and an import goes back to origin after one failed attempt. We have not been told by anyone whether a unit line can be added while the charges hold is on. Address-line questions on held imports go to Routing control, Plover Arc Logistics by Email.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask Routing control to rule on adding the unit line to DL-942 while charges are open, setting out the two conflicting statements and supplying the line.

must: Asks Routing control to say whether the unit line can be added to DL-942 now, setting out both statements as unconfirmed: Import billing's 'no amendments while charges are outstanding' and the depot supervisor's doubt that an import address can be changed at all
Gives the exact line to add, 'Fenn & Thistle Framing, Unit 14', and the depot's warning that without a unit it fails as address incomplete and returns to origin after one attempt
Says the charges are not refused or overdue: the link is valid to 17 August and she has said she will pay
Tells Routing control she has been through three contacts without an answer, including a follow-up email that could not be read
must_not: Tells the recipient the address cannot be noted until the import charges are paid, or makes the request to Routing control conditional on payment
Tells the recipient the unit line has been or will be added before Routing control confirms it
Tells the recipient an import address cannot be changed
Treats the charges as refused or overdue, or presses her to pay sooner than the notice requires
Sends her back to the billing line or the depot to ask again
expected.reference_message: DL-942, held import at Destination depot. The label reads 'T. Roux, Copperwell Arcade, Harrow Quay' with no unit. The recipient, Thandiwe Roux, asks for one line to be added: Fenn & Thistle Framing, Unit 14. She has had two different answers and neither is confirmed: Import billing's phone agent told her no amendment is possible while import charges are outstanding, and the depot supervisor told her he was not sure an import address can be changed at all and that it is your decision. The depot says an arcade parcel with no unit comes back as 'address incomplete' and an import returns to origin after one failed attempt. The charges are not refused or overdue: the payment link runs to 17 August and she says she will pay on Friday. Please confirm whether the unit line can be added now, independent of the charges hold, and add it if so. For priority: she has asked three times, and the depot's follow-up email to her arrived unreadable.

rationale: Import billing says nothing changes until the fee is paid; the depot supervisor doubts the address can change at all and says it is Routing control's call. Neither statement is proven and neither speaker owns address lines. The desk should not repeat either to the recipient: it sends both, the exact unit line and the return-to-origin risk to Routing control, and makes clear the charge was never refused.

review.note: Coordinator put both unconfirmed statements and the exact unit line to Routing control by Email and told the recipient nothing.
